card.text: TOI-677 b crosses TOI-677 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-677 b"
sources.quote: TOI-677 b (TOI-677b) is a warm super-Jupiter type exoplanet orbiting the F-type main sequence star TOI-677 in the constellation of Ophiuchus about 466 ly (143 pc) away from Earth.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Jordán et al. 2020.

sources.label: Jordán et al. (2020), The Astronomical Journal 159 145

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-677 b"
sources.quote: The mass of the planet has been found to be 1.252 Jupiter masses and the radius of the planet is 1.179 Jupiter radii.
